result.question: How did Zebul describe the men?

readings.answer: as the shadows of the mountains
readings.support: The shadows of the mountains look like men to you
Are these not the people you ridiculed

assessments.reason: Zebul says, “The shadows of the mountains look like men to you,” which matches the key’s “Shadows of the hills.”
In verse 38 Zebul also refers to them as “the people you ridiculed,” which is another way he describes the men within the same passage.

result.reason: Zebul describes the men both as shadows of the mountains (v.36) and as the people Gaal ridiculed (v.38), so the question allows more than one materially different answer.
